tool_args.rationale: The short-horizon observations show a sink-dependent positive base, while the long-horizon measurements reverse sign. Fit a siphon base plus a saturating negative adaptation numerically, then test it on fresh confirmation data.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The eight observations span short and long horizons and constrain a five-parameter sink-coupled adaptation hypothesis; confirmation is the next informative test.
It omits the sink-gradient dependence evident in the pilot.
